units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b">Snh. 97ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 45b:6">Succ. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>לא פ׳ עלמא וכ׳</he> (ed. <he>פחות</he>) the world has never less than thirty-six righteous men worthy to face the Shekhinah, in every generation.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:22">Lam. R. to III, 16</cite> after having eaten all his food <he>נסיב חד פת פ׳ וכ׳</he> he took a broken loaf and put ashes on it.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib. to I, 1</cite> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) <he>הדא מנהון פ׳ וסמיכא וכ׳</he> one of them (beds) was broken and leaning against another bed; a. e.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:3">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> [read:] <he>ואת בעי … להדא פ׳</he> and thou wouldst forsake thy God and bow to his wretched (idol)?
